$description: Vaani Labs design tokens (Sutradhar direction). Canonical source for tokens.css, tailwind.theme.css and tailwind.preset.js (regenerate with `node build-tokens.mjs`). Modes: light is $value; dark lives in $extensions["in.vaanilabs.modes"].dark. Role aliases carry $extensions["in.vaanilabs.alias"].

in.vaanilabs.meta.changes: 1.1.0: info is neutral; Neel leaves charts except the highlighted datum; teal sequential ramp; talk-strip and diff tokens; lower-chroma dark selection tint; mono-20 deprecated (timers are Hanken num-20); display-48; dur-spin, live-pulse-cycles, shift-sheet; timing additions; component.* and interaction groups (the token register, spec/01-foundations.md §18).

100.$description: Light surface-3; dark text (merged with the direction's first dark-text anchor)

200.$description: Light border-strong; light Baseline text (11.4:1 on ink)

350.$description: Dark text-3 (>= 4.5:1 on every dark plane)

400.$description: Light control border and canvas edges (>= 3:1 on every light plane). Replaced the first anchor, which failed 1.4.11 on surface-2 (01-foundations §0).

500.$description: Dark control border (>= 3:1 on every dark plane). Replaced the first anchor, which failed on surface-3 (01-foundations §0).

550.$description: Light text-3 (>= 4.5:1 on every light plane); dark disabled text

650.$description: Dark overlay border; dark Baseline top hairline

800.$description: Dark surface-3 (merged with the direction's first dark Baseline anchor)

graphite.$description: Cool graphite neutral ramp, hue ~220-230 deg. 0 is white, 1000 the darkest dark-theme background. Every step has one job; the job is noted where it matters.

ink.$description: Brand ink. Light text, the ink glyph tile (Trigger) and the inverse surface. Continues the product's current ink. The Baseline band and the mark tile use neel.ink.

50.$description: Light accent-soft (selection only; info is neutral since 1.1.0)

75.$description: Light hover on a selected row (keeps text-3 >= 4.5:1 and control >= 3:1)

300.$description: Dark accent-soft text, dark link hover

400.$description: Dark accent text, focus and marks (8.3:1 on the dark surface); focus inside the Baseline

550.$description: Dark accent hover (white label 5.2:1, above the 5:1 trap)

700.$description: Light accent fill, text, focus and marks (white label 8.5:1); dark accent press

800.$description: Light accent hover; light accent-soft text

900.$description: Light accent press; dark text selection

925.$description: Dark hover on a selected row (text-3 4.9:1, control 3.1:1 on it).

950.$description: Dark accent-soft. Low chroma (OKLCH C 0.032) so a selected row reads as a tint, never a navy slab.

ink.$description: Neel-ink: the Baseline band in both themes and the mark tile. Indigo dye at its darkest; reads as navy, not black.

neel.$description: Neel (indigo dye) accent ramp. OKLCH hue ~260 (HSL ~218), lower chroma than a screen blue; the only chromatic brand colour. Re-keyed 2026-09-27 away from the ~230-245 deg SaaS indigo band (Linear's indigo is 234 deg). neel.ink is the Baseline band and the mark tile.

400.$description: Dark success solid and live dot

500.$description: Sentiment positive (chart mark, both themes). Lighter than the negative red so the pair separates for deuteranopes.

550.$description: Light live dot (>= 3:1 on every light plane, incl. success-soft). Replaced the first anchor, which fell below 3:1 on surface-2 (01-foundations §0).

green.$description: Success and live. Never an action colour.

300.$description: Dark warning solid and text; Baseline warn in both themes

600.$description: Light warning solid and border (white label 5.0:1)

amber.$description: Warning, pending (dialling, ringing, on hold) and low balance. Never standalone text on white except the 700 step.

700.$description: Light danger text; light sentiment negative

red.$description: Danger and failed. Destructive actions and errors only.

bg.$description: Page background: behind content, the sidebar, and around cards.

surface.$description: The main working plane: tables, panels, forms, inputs.

surface-2.$description: Inset on a surface: hovered rows, caller turns, fallback answer rows, gate footers, code.

surface-3.$description: Pressed states, progress tracks, the tinted Action glyph tile, skeletons.

surface-raised.$description: Popovers, menus, nodes, the bulk bar. Same fill as surface; lifted by --e1/--e2.

surface-overlay.$description: Dialogs, sheets and gates. Same fill as surface; lifted by --e3 plus --border-overlay.

border.$description: Hairlines between rows, panels and regions. Decorative, no contrast requirement.

border-strong.$description: Node edges, secondary button edges, table frames, filter tokens.

border-overlay.$description: Edge of popovers, dialogs, sheets and gates.

control.$description: Borders of anything you type into or tick, the off switch track, sockets. >= 3:1 on every plane.

text-2.$description: Secondary text: idle nav, body-secondary, table cells that are not the key column.

text-3.$description: Tertiary text: meta, helper text, placeholders, table headers, timecodes. Still >= 4.5:1 everywhere.

text-dis.$description: Disabled text only. Exempt from contrast; always paired with a reason nearby.

accent.$description: Neel fill: the one primary button per region, checked checkbox/radio/switch.

accent-text.$description: Neel as text or icon on neutral planes: links, the active nav icon.

accent-soft.$description: Selection fill only: selected rows, chips, segments, step headers. Never info notices, never a persistent panel-sized fill.

accent-soft-text.$description: Text on accent-soft (a selected chip, the active phase segment, a search match). {{variable}} chips moved to --variable-* in 1.1.0.

accent-mark.$description: Non-text Neel indicators: selection borders and bars, active tab underline, progress fill, minimap viewport. >= 3:1 on every plane.

focus-inverse.$description: Focus outline on inverse planes (toasts, the light Baseline).

success.$description: Success solid: dots, filled badges, bars.

success-text.$description: Success text on success-soft, surface or bg.

success-border.$description: Success stroke where the border carries the state.

warning.$description: Warning solid: ringing dot, node warning border, low-balance marker.

warning-text.$description: Warning text. The only amber allowed as text on light planes.

warning-soft.$description: Warning tint: blocking notices, unconnected answer rows.

warning-border.$description: Warning stroke where the border carries the state.

danger.$description: Danger solid: error borders on nodes and fields, failed dot.

danger-text.$description: Danger text and the danger-outline button.

danger-soft.$description: Danger tint: error notices, danger button hover.

danger-border.$description: Danger stroke where the border carries the state.

info.$description: Info icon colour. Info is neutral (graphite), not Neel: an info notice must never look like a selection. An alias, so it follows inverse planes.

info-soft.$description: Info tint: the inset plane (alias of --surface-2).

info-border.$description: Info notice and tag edge: structure, not state (alias of --border-strong).

live.$description: The live dot. The only colour that may pulse: 3 cycles each time a call enters Live, on the focal CallHeader only; every other live dot is static.

bl-bg.$description: Baseline band: Neel-ink in both themes. The one place the brand colour appears at scale on every screen; the only dark band in the light theme.

bl-text.$description: Baseline text (>= 8:1 on Neel-ink in both themes).

bl-sep.$description: Baseline segment separators (a lighter Neel on the Neel-ink band).

bl-line.$description: Baseline top hairline (visible in dark only).

bl-warn.$description: A blocked or low Baseline segment. The only third colour allowed in the Baseline.

canvas-dot.$description: Canvas dot grid: 1 px dots every 16 px. The only texture in the product.

edge.$description: Connections between steps (solid) and the fallback path (dashed, the only dashed line).

edge-active.$description: Edges of the selected step and the one-shot test trace.

ink-tile.$description: Trigger glyph tile (solid ink). The mark no longer uses it; see mark-bg.

mark-bg.$description: The mark tile (the cord). Neel-ink in both themes, so the mark and the Baseline carry the same brand colour.

mark-fg.$description: The two strands of the mark on its tile.

scrim.$description: Flat scrim behind modal dialogs and sheets. No blur.

chart-1.$description: Categorical series 1 (Ink). Also every single-series mark (via --chart-neutral). Validated with teal, ochre, rose: adjacent CVD >= 10.9, normal >= 18.0 (dark needs graphite-250: graphite-300 is 14.5 from teal).

chart-other.$description: Everything beyond 4 series folds into Other (Slate), always last and always labelled "Other". Light: CVD 9.8 from rose; dark: 7.9 (legal with its label and 2 px gap).

chart-neutral.$description: Role alias of --chart-1: single-series and ranked marks (bars per period, funnel fills, bar lists, hour bars, trend lines).

seq-1.$description: Sequential (magnitude) step 1 of 5, lowest. Teal, OKLCH-even (hue 186), never Neel. Charts sit on --surface.

sentiment-positive.$description: Sentiment chart mark: positive. Always with an icon and the word.

sentiment-neutral.$description: Sentiment chart mark: neutral (grey, never mustard; F-VIS-011).

sentiment-negative.$description: Sentiment chart mark: negative. Lighter green vs darker red keeps them apart for deuteranopes.

frame-neel.$description: User-chosen frame tint (neel): 6% (light) / 10% (dark) of the chart hue over the canvas. Lower chroma than any status soft.

frame-teal.$description: User-chosen frame tint (teal): 6% (light) / 10% (dark) of the chart hue over the canvas. Lower chroma than any status soft.

frame-ochre.$description: User-chosen frame tint (ochre): 6% (light) / 10% (dark) of the chart hue over the canvas. Lower chroma than any status soft.

frame-rose.$description: User-chosen frame tint (rose): 6% (light) / 10% (dark) of the chart hue over the canvas. Lower chroma than any status soft.

frame-slate.$description: User-chosen frame tint (slate): 6% (light) / 10% (dark) of the chart hue over the canvas. Lower chroma than any status soft.

talk-caller.$description: Talk strip, caller lane segments (>= 3:1 on the surface-2 lane track).

chart-highlight.$description: Role alias of --accent-mark: the hovered, focused or selected datum. The only Neel inside a chart.

diff-added-bg.$description: Compare mode: an added step or row (always with the word "Added").

diff-removed-bg.$description: Compare mode: a removed step or row (always with the word "Removed" and strike-through).

diff-changed-bg.$description: Compare mode: a changed step or row (always with the word "Changed"). Never accent.

diff-changed-bar.$description: Compare mode: the 2 px inline-start bar on a changed step or row.

e0.$description: Flat. Structure comes from 1 px hairlines.

e1.$description: Nodes, secondary buttons, the active nav key. Dark: none (the element's own border carries it).

e2.$description: Popovers, menus, the selected node. Pair with --border-overlay.

e3.$description: Dialogs, sheets, gates, the bulk bar, toasts. Pair with --border-overlay.

sans.$description: Hanken Grotesk for all UI and marketing. "Vaani Rupee" is a self-hosted U+20B9 subset (Hanken has no rupee glyph). Indic Noto faces load per script via unicode-range.

mono.$description: Only for ids, {{variables}}, code, API keys and keycaps. Phones, timers, timecodes and durations are Hanken with tabular-nums.

typography.$description: Type roles. Sizes in rem so user font-size settings apply (F-VIS-002). Nothing below 12 px. Weights 400/500/600 only.

display-40.$description: 40/48 · 600 · -0.025em. First-run display (Home, "Get your first call live"); marketing section heads.

title-24.$description: 24/32 · 600 · -0.015em. Setup and overview headings, auth H1, marketing H3.

title-20.$description: 20/28 · 600 · -0.01em. Page H1. The only H1 style in the app.

title-16.$description: 16/24 · 600. Section headings (H2) in a page; panel, sheet, dialog and gate titles; phone top-bar title.

title-14.$description: 14/20 · 600. Subsections (H3), card titles, step (node) titles, transcript header.

num-20.$description: 20/28 · 500 · -0.01em, tabular. KPIs on phone tiles and dense cards; the live call timer.

body-16.$description: 16/24 · 400. Marketing body; every text input on touch and phone (prevents iOS focus zoom).

read-15.$description: 15/24 · 400. Transcript turns, Assistant replies, knowledge passages.

body-14.$description: 14/20 · 400. Default UI text: descriptions, dialog body, text inputs on desktop.

label-13.$description: 13/20 · 500. Field labels, buttons (28 and 32 px), nav items, tabs, filter tokens, the key table column.

data-13.$description: 13/20 · 400. Table cells, list rows, inspector values, toolbar text, answer-row labels (500).

meta-12.$description: 12/16 · 400. Captions, helper text, timestamps, pager, Baseline, bilingual answer examples. The floor.

label-12.$description: 12/16 · 500. Table headers, sidebar group labels, gate section labels, tags, bottom-bar labels. Sentence case.

phase-12.$description: 12/16 · 600. Phase word on steps ("Logic · Question") and node issue badges.

mono-20.$description: DEPRECATED. 20/28 · 500. Was the live call timer; use num-20.
mono-20.$deprecated: Since 1.1.0. The live timer is num-20 (Hanken, tabular). Lint rejects new uses; removed in 2.0.0.

mono-13.$description: 13/20 · 400. Ids, {{variables}}, API keys, code blocks. Never phone numbers, timers or durations (Hanken tabular).

mono-12.$description: 12/16 · 400. Keycaps (500) and ids in meta rows. Timecodes are meta-12 tabular.

display-48.$description: 48/52 · 600 · -0.03em. Marketing display at 768-1279 (the named tablet step of display-56).

space.$description: 4 px base. 2, 6 and 10 are half-steps for component internals only (<= 12 px).

space-role.$description: Semantic spacing. Use these in layouts before reaching for raw steps.

label-gap.$description: Label to control; control to helper text.

inline-xs.$description: Icon to text inside tags and chips.

inline-sm.$description: Icon to text in buttons and nav items.

6.$description: Buttons, inputs, menus, filter tokens, answer rows, glyph tiles.

8.$description: Panels, cards, steps (nodes), table frames, toasts.

radius.$description: "Machined, not soft." No pill buttons, tags or chips.

full.$description: Only avatars, the live dot, switches and the capsule ends of Trigger and Outcome steps.

border-width.$description: 1 px does structural work. 2 px only for focus, selection bars and the active tab.

focus-offset-inset.$description: Rows and list items inside scroll containers.

rail.$description: Icon rail, 1024-1279 (expands to 232 as an overlay).

left-panel.$description: Flow Designer left panel at >= 1024 (Add step, Outline, Variables, Version history). Replaces --size-outline-panel and --size-outline.

left-panel-tablet.$description: Flow Designer Outline column in Review mode (768-1023).

container-form.$description: Settings and create forms; reading column.

container-page.$description: Overview pages: Home, Analytics, Billing, Knowledge.

breakpoint.$description: Min-width breakpoints. Phone < 768, tablet 768-1023, laptop 1024-1439 (rail below 1280), desktop >= 1440. 1920 is a verification width, not a breakpoint.

2xl.$description: Desktop: docked sheets, Cockpit calls column.

grid.$description: Page grid per breakpoint. Tables, the canvas and the Cockpit are fluid inside the margins; dashboards and forms use the columns.

$value.shell: top bar 52 + bottom bar 56 + More sheet

z.$description: Named layers. Popovers sit above modals because menus and selects inside a dialog portal to <body>.

raised.$description: Selected step over edges; sticky first column.

chrome.$description: Sidebar, rail, top and bottom bars, Baseline, canvas controls.

overlay.$description: Non-modal sheets over content, rail expansion.

popover.$description: Menus, selects, comboboxes, the Call gate popover.

opacity.$description: Opacity is for graphics only (icons, tiles, sockets, strokes, markers), never on an ancestor of text, never for text colours or disabled controls. The drag ghost is the one exception (transient, aria-hidden).

dim.$description: Glyph tiles, sockets and connectors outside the emphasised phase or Find result (restores on hover or focus); their text stays at full contrast on --surface-2.

partial.$description: Pending segment of the talk strip (a bar, no text).

unreachable.$description: Glyph tile, sockets and connectors of an unreachable step or a removed step in compare mode; the step's text stays at full contrast with "Not connected" or "Removed".

drag.$description: Drag ghost (transient, aria-hidden copy; the one exception to the ancestor-of-text rule).

duration.$description: "A relay clicking." Nothing in the app runs longer than 200 ms except the one-shot trace, the bounded live pulse (3 x 1.6 s) and busy indicators bound to a request in flight.

trace.$description: One-shot test-run trace along an edge.

pulse.$description: One LiveDot pulse cycle (3 cycles per entry into Live, focal CallHeader only) and one indeterminate-bar pass.

spin.$description: One spinner turn, linear. Spinners exist only while a user-started request is in flight.

skeleton-delay.$description: Show a skeleton only if loading takes longer than this.

validate-debounce.$description: Flow validation after each change; also palette record search and autosave (the one input debounce).

announce-throttle.$description: At most one transcript announcement per window.

toast.$description: Informational toasts; pauses on hover and focus. Errors and Undo toasts persist until dismissed.

skeleton-min.$description: A skeleton or busy state, once shown, stays at least this long.

state-announce.$description: Call-state announcement debounce (a sub-second Dialling to Ringing flip announces once).

call-stale.$description: A call stuck in Dialling or Ringing this long shows "No update for 60 s".

refit-debounce.$description: Canvas re-fit after a container resize.

motion-shift.$description: Entrance offsets. All become 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

sheet.$description: Sheet slide from its edge (a percentage of the sheet). 0 under reduced motion: the sheet fades in place.

density.$description: Data surfaces only. Forms, dialogs and the inspector always use standard; touch overrides both.

touch.$description: Automatic on pointer: coarse or below 768 px.

component.$description: Component tokens accepted from the component, page, flow, responsive and motion specs (register: spec/01-foundations.md §18). Each key is its CSS custom property name. Colour entries are theme-split and emitted in the theme blocks; the rest in :root.

nav-hover-bg.$description: Hovered nav item. In dark, surface-3 would outrank the active key.

nav-active-bg.$description: The current page key: the strongest item in both themes.

nav-active-border.$description: Edge of the current page key.

danger-hover.$description: Solid destructive button hover (dark danger-text equals danger, so it needs its own step).

qr.$description: UPI QR code (03-pages/05-knowledge-billing §3). Fixed in both themes: a scannable code never inverts.

flow.$description: Flow Designer (04-flow-designer/01 §20.2, 02 §20, 05-responsive §19). The left panel widths are --size-left-panel and --size-left-panel-tablet in the size group.

size-node-logic.$description: Logic step width (answer rows need room)

size-node-outcome.$description: Outcome step width (room for the status tag)

size-answer-row.$description: Answer row height in the Full band

grid-snap.$description: Snap grid and canvas dot spacing (JS reads this value; there is no separate snapGrid constant)

edge-dash.$description: The one dash pattern: the fallback path (foundations §7)

edge-hover.$description: Hovered connector and connectors of the selection.

size-turn-gutter.$description: TurnRow timecode gutter (48 below 360 px containers)

size-view-summary.$description: Call reports view-summary bar (counted in the chrome budget)

size-scrollrow-fade.$description: Edge fade of a horizontally scrolling row

form.$description: Field widths (02-components-core §1.3). Pages use these names; core no longer declares them.

size-palette-list.$description: Command palette list height: nine rows at the current density

live-pulse-cycles.$description: LiveDot pulse cycles per entry into Live, on the focal CallHeader only; 0 under reduced motion.

interaction.$description: JS-only constants (never emitted to CSS). Import from tokens.json; one name each (07-motion §18, 04-flow-designer/01 §20.2). Distances in CSS px, times in ms.

safeAreaInset.$description: Fraction of the viewport kept clear when panning a target into view

lodFull.$description: Zoom at and above which steps render in the Full band

lodCompact.$description: Zoom at and above which steps render Compact (below it: Overview)
